lines.en: label day30:
scene drown0
And so ends another uneventful day as a school teacher.
lines.zh: 于是，又一个平淡无奇的教师之日结束了。

lines.en: I’ve gotta say, the fact that I've made it this far without being fired or reprimanded is either extremely impressive on my end, or extremely worrying on the school's.
lines.zh: 我得说，我能撑到现在还没被开除或挨批，要么是我本人极其了不起，要么是这所学校极其让人担忧。

lines.en: But hey, the fact that none of the staff members have caught on to the person I really am yet is definitely good for me.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，教职工里还没人识破我的真面目，这对我来说绝对是好事。

lines.en: It also shows that, for whatever reason, the girls have some level of trust in me.
lines.zh: 这也说明，不知为何，那些女生对我抱有某种程度的信任。

lines.en: I guess it's a little strange that Yumi hasn't ratted me out to the higher ups, but...well, I guess she hasn't really had the time {i}to{/i} do that with all of her absences.
lines.zh: Yumi 还没把我捅给上面，想来是有点奇怪，不过……嗯，她缺勤那么多次，大概{i}真没那个时间{/i}。

lines.en: For all she knows, this might be how Sensei has been doing things all along.
lines.zh: 在她看来，说不定 Sensei 一直以来就是这么做事的。

lines.en: scene drown1
I step into the cafe for a quick drink in the midst of my aimless wandering and hope that there is someone or something in here with the potential to entertain me for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: 我在漫无目的地闲逛途中走进咖啡馆想喝一杯，盼着这里能有什么人或什么东西，有本事让我消磨掉剩下的大半天。

lines.en: And, noticing two students of mine no more than twenty feet away from me, I realize that I have once again accidentally manifested exactly what I have been looking for.
lines.zh: 而当我注意到离我不到二十英尺的地方坐着我的两个学生时，我意识到自己又一次无意中招来了我一直在找的东西。

lines.en: scene drown2
: Woah, Sensei?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，Sensei？！你怎么会在这儿？！

lines.en: : Wait, really? He’s never here this late.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？他从来不会这么晚来这儿。

lines.en: scene drown3
: Sensei! Come hang out with us! We were actually just talking about you!
lines.zh: : Sensei！过来跟我们一起玩！我们刚才还在聊你呢！

lines.en: scene drown5
: Were you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! Nothing super interesting, though. Just how we're happy to have you as our teacher and not any of the other ones.
lines.zh: : 对啊！不过也不是什么特别有意思的事。就是觉得很高兴你当我们老师，而不是别的那些人。

lines.en: : Does that have anything to do with how I've given up on assigning schoolwork?
lines.zh: : 这跟我放弃布置作业有关系吗？

lines.en: : I mean...that definitely helps!
lines.zh: : 我是说……那肯定有帮助啊！

lines.en: : So, what are you up to? It's not every day I see you two together.
lines.zh: : 那么，你们在忙什么？我可不是每天都能看到你俩在一起。

lines.en: scene drown6
: Right? I was just telling Rin that the other day that we need to hang out more.
lines.zh: : 对吧？我前几天还跟 Rin 说，我们该多一起出去玩。

lines.en: : Hahah...I'm Rin.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……我是 Rin。

lines.en: : That's...a thing that I was told.
lines.zh: : 那是……别人告诉过我的一句话。

lines.en: : I’m not...interrupting anything, am I?
lines.zh: : 我没有……打扰到什么吧？

lines.en: : No way! Not at all!
lines.zh: : 怎么可能！完全没有！

lines.en: : Besides, shouldn't you be {i}trying{/i} to hang out with us after that whole {i}let's be friends{/i} thing?
lines.zh: : 再说了，既然你说了{i}要当朋友{/i}，那你不是也该{i}试着{/i}跟我们多混混吗？

lines.en: : Friends don't just walk past other friends, Sensei. That'd be like, totally messed up.
lines.zh: : 朋友可不会就这么从另一个朋友身边走过去，Sensei。那也太说不过去了。

lines.en: : Hey, I agree. I just didn't want to be interrupting a date or anything.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我同意。我只是不想打扰你们的约会什么的。

lines.en: scene drown7
: Hahahah! A date?!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！约会？！

lines.en: : I guess it does kinda look like that, doesn't it?!
lines.zh: : 我想是有点像那么回事吧，对吧？！

lines.en: : {i}Please don't leave me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请别丢下我。{/i}

lines.en: Something tells me I probably shouldn't leave Rin right now.
lines.zh: 有个声音告诉我，现在大概不该丢下 Rin 走人。

lines.en: It's her. She's the one who tells me that.
lines.zh: 是她。就是她在告诉我这件事。

lines.en: : Well, I’m happy to hang out here if you two are okay with it. And I guess just...tell me to leave if you wind up wanting to be alone or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是你俩不介意，我很乐意在这儿待着。还有就是……要是你们想单独待着什么的，直接叫我走就行。

lines.en: scene drown8
: I think we'll be okay. But it's nice knowing that you'd support us if things were a little different, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们没问题的。不过知道要是情况不太一样、你会支持我们，这点挺好的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Everything okay, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Rin？

lines.en: scene drown9
: Huh? What? Yeah. I'm good. Green as a cucumber.
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？嗯。我很好。像黄瓜一样绿。

lines.en: : Isn't it {i}cool{/i} as a cucumber?
lines.zh: : 不是「像黄瓜一样{i}酷{/i}」吗？

lines.en: scene drown10
: It {i}is{/i} kind of cool in here, isn't it?! Should I turn the heat up? I know it's summer and that it will conflict with the air conditioner, but if that's what you-
lines.zh: : 这里{i}确实{/i}是有点凉，对吧？！要我把暖气打开吗？我知道现在是夏天，而且会和空调冲突，不过如果你想——

lines.en: : What? No. I meant, like...the phrase. Isn't the phrase {i}as cool as a cucumber?{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我是说……那个说法。那个说法不是「{i}像黄瓜一样冷静{/i}」吗？

lines.en: scene drown10r
: Hahah! Yeah! They {i}are{/i} pretty cool, aren't they?!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！对啊！黄瓜{i}确实{/i}挺酷的，对吧？！

lines.en: Wow.
lines.zh: 哇。

lines.en: Rin is...not very good around Chika, is she?
lines.zh: Rin 在 Chika 面前……相当不行啊，对吧？

lines.en: scene drown11
: You know...maybe Sensei's onto something? You {i}have{/i} seemed kinda weird ever since we got here. Are you sure everything is okay?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……也许 Sensei 说得有道理？我们从到这儿开始你就{i}一直{/i}有点怪。你确定真的没事吗？

lines.en: : You don’t like, feel uncomfortable hanging out with me...do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会……跟我在一起觉得不自在吧？

lines.en: scene drown12
: What?! No! Of course not! It's not like that at all!
lines.zh: : 什么？！没有！当然没有！根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: : I’m just...really tired!
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的很累！

lines.en: : I didn’t sleep much last night and I’m like, totally running on fumes right now.
lines.zh: : 我昨晚没怎么睡，现在完全就是靠最后一口气在撑着。

lines.en: : You sure it’s not me? I know I can be kinda chatty sometimes, but that's just because-
lines.zh: : 你确定不是因为我？我知道我有时候话是有点多，不过那只是因为——

lines.en: : Totally sure! You’re not doing anything wrong! You’re great, in fact! So great! Way better than I am!
lines.zh: : 绝对不是！你什么都没做错！事实上你棒极了！真的棒极了！比我好太多了！

lines.en: : And, umm...
lines.zh: : 而且，呃……

lines.en: : Uhh!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！

lines.en: scene drown13
: {i}Help.{/i}
I think you might be a little past helping right now, Rin...But I'll do my best.
lines.zh: 我觉得你现在大概已经救不回来了，Rin……不过我会尽力。

lines.en: : Wow. I sure am hungry right now. If only there was some place to get food around here...
lines.zh: : 哇。我现在可真饿啊。要是这附近有个能弄到吃的地方就好了……

lines.en: scene drown13r
: Yes! Food! I will go find us food!
lines.zh: : 对！吃的！我去给大家找吃的！

lines.en: : I work here, so I know where we keep all of it!
lines.zh: : 我在这儿打工，所以我知道东西都放在哪儿！

lines.en: : Three foods, coming right Chika!
lines.zh: : 三份吃的，马上就 Chika！

lines.en: scene drown13r2
: Up! Coming right up! Not Chika. Chika is you! Not coming at all!
lines.zh: : 上来！马上就好！不是 Chika。Chika 是你！根本没在来！

lines.en: : Uhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Okay, bye! Thank you!
lines.zh: : 好的，拜！谢谢！

lines.en: scene drown15
scene drown16
: It’s me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是我的问题，对吧？

lines.en: : I like, totally wasn’t picking up on her cues or anything. I’m talking way too much again, I know it.
lines.zh: : 我完全没接收到她的暗示什么的。我又说太多了，我知道。

lines.en: : God...I told myself I would do this and everything. I'm so disappointed in myself right now.
lines.zh: : 天哪……我都跟自己说好了要这么做的，什么都说好了。我现在对自己太失望了。

lines.en: : I don’t really think that’s the problem, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我真不觉得问题出在那儿，Chika。

lines.en: : Then what is it? There's no way she's just {i}tired,{/i} right? She's yelling way too much for someone who's {i}that{/i} tired.
lines.zh: : 那是什么？她不可能只是{i}累了{/i}，对吧？一个{i}那么{/i}累的人，喊得也太起劲了。

lines.en: : She was totally fine at[school], too...She didn't start acting weird until we got here.
lines.zh: : 她在[school]的时候也完全正常……我们到了这儿她才开始变得怪怪的。

lines.en: : It’s like the second we’re alone, some...{i}switch{/i} flips and she turns into a completely different person.
lines.zh: : 就好像我们一单独相处，某个……{i}开关{/i}就啪地一翻，她就变成了完全另一个人。

lines.en: : I just don't want it to be my fault, you know? I thought this would be fun.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想这是我的错，你懂吗？我本来以为会很好玩的。

lines.en: : Well, are {i}you{/i} having fun?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那{i}你{/i}现在觉得好玩吗？

lines.en: scene drown17
: I mean...I {i}wanna{/i} say yeah...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我{i}想{/i}说好玩……

lines.en: : But, like...I can’t help but feel like I’m just bothering her right now.
lines.zh: : 不过，那个……我总觉得现在自己只是在烦她。

lines.en: : I’ve known Rin for years now and the two of us haven’t ever really...{i}hung out{/i} before.
lines.zh: : 我认识 Rin 好几年了，可我俩从来没真的……{i}一起出去玩{/i}过。

lines.en: : I don't know. I just feel like it's supposed to feel a lot more...natural than this.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我只是觉得，这种事本该感觉……自然得多才对。

lines.en: : I've gone out with plenty of girlfriends before and none of them have ever acted this...{i}out of place{/i} with me. Is it our styles, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我以前也交过不少女性朋友，她们没有一个在我面前表现得这么……{i}不自在{/i}。也许是风格不合？

lines.en: : I know we don't have that much in common, but it's not like I'm totally uninterested in any of the stuff she's into. I just don't know much about it. And-
lines.zh: : 我知道我俩共同点不多，可我对她喜欢的东西也不是完全没兴趣。我只是不太了解而已。而且——

lines.en: : Chika, I get it. And I think you're worrying too much.
lines.zh: : Chika，我懂。而且我觉得你担心过头了。

lines.en: : I’m sure everything will work out as long as neither of you make a big deal out of it.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，只要你俩都别把这事看得太重，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : She’s probably just having an off day or something.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是今天状态不好什么的。

lines.en: scene drown16
: I really hope that’s all it is...
lines.zh: : 我真的希望只是这样……

lines.en: : I've always, like...
lines.zh: : 我一直都，那个……

lines.en: : Kind of wanted to be friends with her and stuff. She's so...unique.
lines.zh: : 有点想跟她当朋友什么的。她是那么……独一无二。

lines.en: scene drown18
: Okay, I'm back...sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 好了，我回来了……不好意思啊。

lines.en: : I...forgot to ask what everyone wanted, so...I just ordered a bunch of stuff that we can all split.
lines.zh: : 我……忘了问大家想吃什么，所以……我就点了一堆东西，大家分着吃。

lines.en: : My manager said it's on her today, too...so...I guess that's kind of cool. Right?
lines.zh: : 我店长说今天她请客……所以……我想那还挺不错的吧。对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, that's totally fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，完全没问题。

lines.en: scene drown19
: Hey, Rin?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Rin？

lines.en: : Hm? What's up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m sorry if I was...making you feel uncomfortable or anything. I just-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，如果我……让你觉得不自在什么的。我只是——

lines.en: scene drown20
: What? Chika, no! I’m totally fine.
lines.zh: : 什么？Chika，没有！我完全没事。

lines.en: : Like I said, I'm just tired. I...get like this sometimes. I just needed to reset really quick, that's all.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我只是累了。我……有时候会这样。我只是需要快点重启一下，就这样。

lines.en: : Plus, as soon as my coffee cools down and I can get some caffeine into my system, I'm sure I'll be right as a cucumber.
lines.zh: : 再说，等我的咖啡凉下来、我能把咖啡因灌进身体里，我肯定就会像黄瓜一样正常了。

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure it's right as r-
lines.zh: : 我觉得应该是「right as r——」

lines.en: : You know what? Forget it. I'm glad you're feeling better. But just...let me know if I wind up annoying you, okay?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？算了。很高兴你感觉好点了。不过……要是我真惹你烦了，记得告诉我，好吗？

lines.en: scene drown21
: Yeah...
: Yeah, I can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我会的。

lines.en: : I'm sorry too. For...making things awkward and stuff. And...and for all of the cucumber analogies.
lines.zh: : 我也抱歉。为……把气氛搞得这么尴尬什么的。还有……还有那些黄瓜的比喻。

lines.en: : I can assure you that I don't spend any more time thinking about cucumbers than the average girl.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我花在想黄瓜上的时间并不比一般女生多。

lines.en: : Probably even less, to be honest. They're all weird and...
lines.zh: : 老实说大概还更少。它们全都怪怪的，而且……

lines.en: : And bumpy...
lines.zh: : 还坑坑洼洼的……

lines.en: : And...uhh...
: ...And cool?
lines.zh: : ……还很酷？

lines.en: scene drown22
: Pfft!
scene drown23
: Hahah...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : {i}Thank you, Sensei. Let me know if there's anything I can do to make it up to you, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你，Sensei。要是有什么我能补偿你的，记得跟我说，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I wind up leaving the cafe before any of the food arrives so the two of them can spend some more time together.
lines.zh: 最后，我在食物端上来之前就离开了咖啡馆，好让他们俩多待一会儿。

lines.en: It's pretty clear what was going on here today, but...
lines.zh: 今天这儿发生的一切相当明显，不过……

lines.en: Well, let's just say there's no need for me to get in the way right now. Not while everything is still so fresh...
lines.zh: 嗯，这么说吧，现在我没必要横插一脚。至少在一切都还这么崭新的当口……

lines.en: And certainly not before I know either of them well enough to even {i}want{/i} to get myself caught in the early stages of the mess this may become.
lines.zh: 更不必说，在我还没了解她们任何一个人、还没到{i}愿意{/i}把自己卷进这场可能变成的乱局的早期阶段之前。

lines.en: I'll remain on the sidelines for now. I don't have to start every single game.
lines.zh: 我暂时先在场边看着。我没必要每场比赛都首发。

lines.en: But...when I do-
lines.zh: 不过……等我上场的时候——

lines.en: I'll be sure to make an impact.
lines.zh: 我一定会留下影响。

$ chika_love += 1

{i}Rin's affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Before I know it, the day has come to an end and I am on my way home.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等我回过神来，这一天已经结束，人也在回家的路上了。{/i}
